adoption: Character layout and checksum/mirror reconstruction from WizData.cs, WizIO.cs and CRC16.cs. C# reference sources are preserved unchanged, not compiled. ROM-specific C++ adapter only; no emulator core implementation. W1 carry folding corrected against actual-ROM SRAM (multiple carries). W2/3 backup length is 20 * 0x60 as in implementation, not README 0x80 wording. CRC is CRC-16/CCITT 0x1021 as in CRC16.cs, not README CRC-8 wording. Whole-record exchange also adapts WizData.SwapChar / CurrentDataUp / CurrentDataDown in app/save_json.cpp; ROM-specific party slot references are remapped before returning to the title. See docs/roster-order.md.
runtime_dependencies: None beyond standard C++; nlohmann/json handles JSON. Mapper 1/4 execution remains in binjnes.
verification: Known SHA-256 target revisions of FC I/II/III, Windows MSVC. See docs/save-data.md.
